name: Barbell Landmine Squat
steps: Stand facing a barbell anchored at its far end and cup the free sleeve securely in front of your chest with both hands.
Set your feet slightly wider than shoulder width with toes turned slightly out and lean gently into the bar.
Bend your hips and knees to squat smoothly down along the bar's arc until your thighs reach at least parallel.
Drive through your whole foot to stand tall and press your hips forward cleanly at the top.
tips: Keep your elbows tucked close to your ribs and your chest lifted throughout the squat.
Adjust your distance from the sleeve so the natural arc guides you straight into a balanced bottom position.
